source: Bereshit Rabbah 71:9
claim_en: AN INK OBSERVATION ON A MISSING VERB, AND OUR CORPUS CARRIES IT EXACTLY. The chain notes that of the handmaid Zilpah it is written that she BORE without the preceding 'and she conceived', and reads the omission as her youth, the pregnancy inconspicuous. Machine-checked across every birth verse in this block: eleven births are narrated, and 'and she conceived' stands before nine of them - Leah's six, Bilhah's two, Rachel's one - and is absent from exactly the two that are Zilpah's, at 30:10 and 30:12. The observation is not impressionistic; the pattern is complete and the exceptions are exactly the two claimed.
middah: ink (and-she-conceived absent at exactly Zilpah's two births — the pattern checked)

source: Bereshit Rabbah 72:4
claim_en: THE LABOUR DAY'S DEFAULTS ARE DERIVED AT THIS VERSE, WITH THEIR EXCEPTION. From his coming in from the field IN THE EVENING the chain hooks the hire-law: an employer cannot compel rising early or staying late where local custom does not, and the High Court's stipulation is quoted - the going out is on the employer's time, the coming in on the labourer's. The sabbath eve is excepted: then the coming in is on the employer's time too, so there is time to fill the barrel, roast the fish and kindle the lamp. A working-hours default with a named exception, taken from a narrative time-stamp.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 72:6
claim_en: A VAIN-PRAYER RULE IS STATED, LIMITED, DISPUTED, AND THEN OVERRIDDEN BY THIS BLOCK'S OWN VERSE. The received teaching is that praying for a male once the wife is pregnant is a VAIN prayer. The school of R. Yanai limits it to the travailing chair; R. Yehuda ben Pazi objects that even there it can change, citing the potter. The objection from our own 30:21 is then answered: the child's primary creation WAS male and was changed by the sister's prayer - the change licensed by the doctrine that the matriarchs were prophets, since she knew only one son remained. A rule of prayer-efficacy stated and then broken by the narrative it is applied to, with every stage kept.

source: Bereshit Rabbah 71:4
claim_en: THE GRATITUDE THRESHOLD IS FIXED BY A PARABLE ABOUT ENTITLEMENT. Why does thanks appear only at the fourth son? Because the mothers were reckoned three sons each, so the fourth was beyond her share - and the priest at the threshing floor earns no thanks for the measure from his own portion, but does for the handful from what is his to keep. Thanks begins where entitlement ends. The chain also states a population rule at this sequence - 'therefore' marks a large population - and pairs a tribe with the one that will heal the wound it produces.

claim_en: A PARTNERSHIP BETWEEN STUDY AND COMMERCE IS CHARTERED HERE, WITH ITS NUMBERS. From the mediated night the chain says two tribes stood, and reads them as a compact - one sits in study, the other sails and feeds him, and by that arrangement the Torah proliferates. The numbers are given: the studying tribe is ninth in birth order but offers second, so rank in study beats rank in birth; two hundred heads of the high court came from it; the understanding of the times is read as the calendar intercalations; and the merchant brother's blessing is placed first. Even the herald is recorded - the donkey's braying told her he was coming.

claim_en: THE WHOLE FERTILITY NARRATIVE IS RUN ON PRAYER-ACCEPTANCE IN THE TRANSLATION.
